LANDING_FAQ_1_Q: Do I need the WhatsApp Business API to try this?
LANDING_FAQ_1_A: No. The whole ordering pipeline runs against a built-in simulator, so you can see a message become a priced order today. Connecting a real number is a settings change later, not a different product.
LANDING_FAQ_2_Q: Can the AI get my numbers wrong?
LANDING_FAQ_2_A: It never produces a number. The model reads your question and picks which report to run; the arithmetic is done by the same code that prints your invoices. That boundary is deliberate and it is not configurable.
LANDING_FAQ_3_Q: What happens if someone makes a mistake?
LANDING_FAQ_3_A: Nothing is edited away. Stock, customer balances and payables are append-only ledgers, so a correction is a new entry with a reason attached — and you can always answer why a number is what it is.
LANDING_FAQ_4_Q: Will my cashier see my margins?
LANDING_FAQ_4_A: Only if you are the one who decides they should. Cost, margin and profit are stripped from the response itself for roles without margin access — not merely hidden in the interface.
LANDING_FAQ_5_A: GST, further tax on unregistered buyers, withholding, and inclusive or exclusive pricing. The tax engine is pluggable per country, so the same rules apply everywhere you trade.
